needsNewNodes.name: Exact whole-number subtraction within 100
needsNewNodes.description: Find the nonnegative difference of whole numbers within 100 using any valid elementary method, including mental calculation, inverse addition, or column subtraction.
needsNewNodes.reason: cnm_p032 covers subtracting one-digit numbers or multiples of ten, while cnm_p034 prescribes written subtraction. The displayed task does not require either particular route.

limitations: A correct difference or missing-addend equation does not demonstrate the column-subtraction algorithm.
candidate.changeReason: 32 + 18 = 50 verifies the stated difference. The current inverse-addition equation is correct and sufficient.
